(chat_service.py:555) only receives the set of connected connector names (e.g. {'gmail','outlook'}), never the account labels, when building tools via build_chat_tools (chat_tools.py:245)
risks: Send/reply preview never shows a from-account, so decision #301's 'must show which account' requirement is unmet by design, not by bug
No code path threads ConnectorView.account into prepare_action/issue_plan, so there is nothing to switch even if a UI wanted to render it
Account selection is entirely implicit in which tool name the model calls; nothing in code enforces or logs a reason for that choice
confirm token binds to plan content only, so adding an account field later still needs it inside the hashed plan or it stays unauthenticated
